Prices for the stay of Nov 7 to 9, 2026, as listed on October 3, 2026.

12 Nashville hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on October 3, 2026 for Nov 7 to Nov 9, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Nashville hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 3, 2026 snapshot, at 11 of the 13 Nashville hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Vio.com at 4, Super.com at 3, trivago DEALS at 2, Traveluro at 1 and Tripadvisor.ca at 1. These are the Nashville rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 11 of the 12 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Vio.com at 4, Etrip.net at 3, Super.com at 3, trivago DEALS at 2, Bluepillow.ca at 1, goseek.com at 1 and Traveluro at 1 (a tie counts for each site). At the other 1, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: the study also counts the 1 named below that are not listed on this page. Each hotel below shows every site's all-in price. Taxes and fees at Nashville hotels

At the 9 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 18% ($43 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 17% at Omni Nashville Hotel to 19% at DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Nashville Downtown. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
